english.title: Person other than motor vehicle keeper fail to give information re keeper
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required by or on behalf of the

(A)_[Chief Officer of Police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE..)]_
(B)_[Secretary of State]_

to give information which it was in your power to give and which might have led to the identification of the person who kept a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which it was alleged to have been kept on a road in contravention of section 29 of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994, failed to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to section 46(4) and (5) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.
